newsitem.title: USA: BostonFed to acquire Broadway Capital.
newsitem.headline: BostonFed to acquire Broadway Capital.

text.p: BostonFed Bancorp Inc. said Monday it signed a definitive agreement to acquire Broadway Capital Corp. and its subsidiary, Broadway National Bank, for about $22 million.
Under the agreement, BostonFed will offer $369.31 cash for each Broadway Capital common share. BostonFed said it intends to operate Broadway National Bank as a separate subsidiary.
BostonFed said it expects the deal to immediately enhance earnings per share.

The Burlington, Mass.-based company said the move would add two banking offices north of Boston, bringing its franchise total to 10. BostonFed had assets of $778 million and equity of $88.9 million as of June 30.
Broadway Capital, a closely held company based in Chelsea, Mass., had assets of about $121 million and equity of about $15.3 million as of June 30.
The deal is expected to close in the first quarter of 1997, subject to regulatory approval.
BostonFed's stock rose 37.5 cents to $13.375 on the American Stock Exchange at mid-afternoon.
